title: Do the ARO sizer and 031's in-profit held-pair add stack on the width book?
label: PROVISIONAL -- one era (2023-26), seed 1; follows the re-entry study (50dd2754 -> a7418871). Nothing is adopted or promoted.
why: w_aro_hp (width book + in-profit add) scored 62.06 vs w_aro 51.44 (+3.54 / +7.07), above cs_aro's 59.95 -- but cs_aro runs with the add OFF (WidthBookMixin sets HELD_PAIR_ADD None), so the two are not like-for-like.

cs_aro_hp.thresholds: cs_aro's per-fold agree thresholds (plan_cs_aro.json), copied unchanged; no new pick

add_rule: 031 as promoted: a fresh width-book signal on a pair holding a trade in profit adds one stake, max 1 add, last fill >= 1 h old; every age-based rule restarts from the add; stop / take-profit from the averaged entry. The add stake is 1x proposed (adjust_trade_position does not go through custom_stake_amount), so the sizer weights (1.333x agree / 0.667x disagree) apply to the first fill only. Weights: ARO's (same model key).
instrument: research/tb_model/stack.py: adds in both halves; >= 95% of adds on a trade in profit; 0 exits on an add candle; >= 99% of trades tagged :agree / :disagree; agree share of trades within 0.05 of cs_aro's. Fail -> INCONCLUSIVE, no P&L read
pass: BOTH judge_one(cs_aro_hp, w_aro_hp) [the sizer on top of the add] AND judge_one(cs_aro_hp, cs_aro) [the add on top of the sizer] PASS: both half gains > 0, paired not WORSENED, Sharpe / maxDD not WORSENED; small-margin rule over all four half gains. Either FAIL -> FAIL; either INCONCLUSIVE/MISSING -> INCONCLUSIVE
reported: judge_one(cs_aro_hp, w_aro); trade and add counts; capital deployed (sum of stake x hours held, per half) for cs_aro_hp, cs_aro, w_aro_hp, w_aro -- descriptive only, no leverage-control arm is run
